title: Stray issue_id "--help" junk entry in handoffs/global_queue.json
summary: handoffs/global_queue.json contained a malformed entry with issue_id '--help', empty title/github_issue, and default MAJOR severity. Discovered during GH-291/ISS-0076 (PI-01, CLAUDE.md split) conflict resolution.

root_cause.details: tools/queue_add.py was invoked as 'queue_add.py --help' intending to print usage, but the script treated sys.argv[1] as issue_id unconditionally with no -h/--help handling and no check that the value doesn't look like a flag. Since no --severity/--title/--github-issue followed, the entry was written with empty title/github_issue and the default MAJOR severity.

resolution: Added explicit -h/--help handling to tools/queue_add.py's main() (prints usage, exits 0, before touching sys.argv[1] as issue_id). Added a defense-in-depth check that rejects any issue_id starting with '-' with a clear error (exit 1) rather than silently accepting it. Removed the stray '--help' entry from handoffs/global_queue.json via this tracked commit (not a silent local edit), as the issue's own suggested fix specified.
verification: python tools/queue_add.py --help -> usage printed, exit 0, queue file untouched (confirmed via git diff before/after). python tools/queue_add.py -h -> same. python tools/queue_add.py --bogus -> rejected with clear error, exit 1, queue file untouched. git diff handoffs/global_queue.json shows exactly one entry removed (13 lines), no other changes.
prevention: Any CLI tool under tools/ that treats sys.argv[1] as a required positional argument should check for -h/--help (and ideally reject flag-shaped values) before assigning it, to fail loudly rather than silently accepting garbage input.
